en.headline: Australian man arrested over imitation firearm in Yau Ma Tei
en.dek: Police said a 36-year-old man was seized at a Temple Street bar on Wednesday night after reports of a gun-like object, and later arrested again for alleged criminal damage in custody.
body: Police said they arrested a 36-year-old Australian man on suspicion of possessing an imitation firearm after reports in Yau Ma Tei on Wednesday night. Officers were first alerted at 10.14pm to a man behaving suspiciously near an alley at 213 Shanghai Street while carrying a gun-like object.

A second report came from a bar at 192 Temple Street. Police said they found the man inside the bar and seized a suspected imitation pistol or air pistol. Specialised units including the Counter Terrorism Response Unit attended and some officers were seen in protective gear.

While detained at a Yau Tsim police station, the man was arrested again on suspicion of criminal damage after he allegedly damaged a wall and a smoke detector, police and local reports said. The case was assigned to Yau Tsim District Crime Squad 6.
Police have not alleged that a real firearm was involved. The man has been arrested and the allegations have not been tested in court.

zh.headline: 油麻地酒吧檢仿製手槍 36歲澳洲籍男子被捕
zh.dek: 警方指周三晚接報廟街酒吧有人攜類似手槍物品，當場拘捕男子並檢獲懷疑仿製曲尺氣槍；扣留期間再涉刑事毀壞。
body: 警方表示，周三晚上10時14分接獲報案，指上海街213號後巷對開有形跡可疑男子攜帶類似手槍物品，其後廟街192號酒吧負責人再報稱該男子進入店內。
警員在酒吧內發現該名36歲澳洲籍男子，檢獲一把懷疑仿製曲尺氣槍，以涉嫌管有仿製槍械拘捕。反恐特勤隊等單位到場，部分警員穿上防護裝備。
男子其後被扣留於油尖區警署期間，警方再以涉嫌刑事毀壞拘捕他，指他損毀牆壁及煙霧探測器。案件交由油尖警區刑事調查隊第六隊跟進。
警方並無指涉及真槍。男子只屬被捕，有關指控未經法庭審理。
